control_name: Mandatory ACORD data elements are populated on P&C messages
control_objective: Every P&C message carries fully populated values for all data elements that the ACORD P&C Data Standard and Data Dictionary mark as mandatory, so that downstream carriers and analytics consumers receive complete, usable policy data.
risk_addressed: Missing or null values in ACORD-mandatory elements degrade data quality at downstream consumers, forcing manual rework, breaking automated rating and analytics, and undermining the integrity of the policy book of record.

required_data_elements.business_definition: A data element the ACORD P&C Data Standard / Data Dictionary marks as mandatory on the message.
The source policy record from policy administration used to profile element population.

method.summary: Profile P&C messages against the set of ACORD-mandatory elements, counting nulls in critical elements and computing the mandatory-element population rate.
steps: Resolve the set of ACORD-mandatory P&C elements from the Data Dictionary.
Profile sampled P&C messages and their source policy records.
Count nulls in critical ACORD elements.
Compute the percentage of mandatory elements fully populated.
method.sampling_rule: Profile all in-scope elements across the monthly message population.
method.fallback_logic: If either source is unavailable, mark Not Run and raise a Missing Source item rather than passing.

thresholds.materiality_basis: Any null in a critical ACORD element is a data-quality exception; sub-100% mandatory population is a warning.

pass_criteria: No nulls in critical ACORD elements.
warning_criteria: Fewer than 100% of ACORD-mandatory elements are populated.
fail_criteria: One or more critical ACORD elements contain nulls.
exception_handling: Route to source-system owners to remediate population gaps and re-profile.

assertions.description: No nulls in critical ACORD elements.

downstream_linkage.staleness_rule: Must be re-evidenced each monthly cycle before publishing the data-quality scorecard.

actions_on_fail: Notify Data Architect and source-system owners
